summary: An API endpoint or data-access change that can never return or write another tenant's or user's data.

required_inputs.name: route
required_inputs.description: Path, method and the handler location

required_inputs.name: scope_owner
required_inputs.description: Whether the resource is per-user, per-tenant, program-shared or global

required_inputs.name: schemas
required_inputs.description: Request and response schema names, or the fields if new

required_inputs.name: feature_key
required_inputs.description: Entitlement or feature flag that gates the route, or none with a reason

checklist.rule: Auth dependency first, then scope resolution, then feature gate, then body validation, in that order
checklist.because: Flex admin services route is the accepted pattern; a 307 from the page-oriented guard on an API route was a live defect

checklist.rule: Every query on a scoped model carries the scope predicate on the same statement, including secondary lookups by id
checklist.because: r3cruit3r has 61 raw id lookups in routers and recruit_merges.py fetches by id without a user predicate; Flex tenant content leaked through hardcoded fallbacks six times in two days

checklist.rule: A test proves a second tenant or user gets 404 or 403, using the repo's override mechanism
checklist.because: A static grep is a review cue, not proof; r3cruit3r IDOR holes were closed in PR #12 only after cross-tenant tests existed

checklist.rule: Tests override dependencies through the framework's mechanism, never by patching the module
checklist.because: r3cruit3r mocker.patch of a FastAPI dependency never took effect, so tests passed while calling the real API (commit 063bbcb)

checklist.rule: Declare the response model and use the repo's error envelope; no bare 500
checklist.because: r3cruit3r has 137 response_model uses and the reviewer prompt requires it; Flex uses { error: { code, message } }

checklist.rule: Never write shared or global data on behalf of one tenant or user
checklist.because: r3cruit3r CONTEXT.md: never write to a TransferPortalPlayer on behalf of one coach

checklist.rule: The router is registered where the app includes routers, and the import is proven to succeed
checklist.because: r3cruit3r wraps every include_router in try/except ImportError, so a missing package made AI endpoints 404 silently

checklist.rule: A gated route asserts the feature server-side and the client wraps in the gate component
checklist.because: Flex widgets fired entitlement-gated calls for every tier and logged a 402 per load; CLAUDE.md says never render a blank page

checklist.rule: Tenant identity comes from the proxy or the auth token, never from a client-supplied header
checklist.because: Flex proxy strips inbound x-tenant-slug; LINDA binds the tenant GUC before writes

done_output: route list from the app, showing the new path
a line per query with its scope predicate quoted
the cross-tenant test name and its output
feature key or none with the reason
stop_conditions: the resource is global and the task asks for a per-tenant write
no override mechanism exists to write the cross-tenant test
the route touches a sensitive path without a grant

adapter_fields.name: auth_dependency
adapter_fields.description: Name of the auth guard used on non-public routes

adapter_fields.name: scope_predicate
adapter_fields.description: How scope is applied: user_id equality, tenantId column, or GUC binding

adapter_fields.name: feature_gate_fn
adapter_fields.description: Server-side feature assertion function, if any

adapter_fields.name: test_override_mechanism
adapter_fields.description: How tests replace dependencies, for example app.dependency_overrides

adapter_fields.name: route_registry
adapter_fields.description: Where routers are included and how to list registered routes

adapter_fields.name: raw_query_grep
adapter_fields.description: Grep that lists raw or unscoped queries in the diff
